description_en: Deletes an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage接口删除已创建的共享带宽实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-common-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk145pn4u --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance resides. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly delete the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Valid values: 
          
false (default): The Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is deleted only if it does not contain elastic IP addresses (EIPs).

true: All EIPs are removed from the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance, and then the instance is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除共享带宽实例。取值： 
          
false（默认值）：只删除不包含EIP的共享带宽。

true：将共享带宽实例中的EIP全部移出后，删除共享带宽
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id
